run_convergence_study: run the convergence_study function to sweep FMM formulations and truncations for a 1D metallic grating
simulate_grating_TE_TM: simulate a 1D metallic stripe grating and compute TE and TM polarized reflection coefficients
run_grating_with_custom_wavelength: run simulate_grating with a custom wavelength and pitch to compute reflection for a specific grating design
run_grating_with_jones_formulation: run simulate_grating using the JONES formulation instead of FFT for the eigenmode solver
run_grating_with_parallelogramic_truncat: run simulate_grating with PARALLELOGRAMIC truncation to compare convergence against CIRCULAR truncation
